source: User-supplied hit_screenshots directory; paths below are relative to it
measurement_limits: Orange ROIs include antialiasing and possible reticle interference; bboxes are approximate fill extents, not full glyph metrics.
before_go is a user-labeled exit transition sample, not necessarily adjacent to the previous numbered PNG.
Slash fits use colored glow medians above the hit, not exact engine geometry; bloom affects the positive estimate.
Only one positive and one negative crit are supplied; the random angle range/distribution is unverified.
No full exit sequence or hold timestamps are supplied; total lifetime and runtime clip tick rate are unmeasured.
Orange is the only measured digit color; shared motion for other colors is user direction.
Local Rise size-mod activation and effective render scaling are unverified.

outline_row_profile.interpretation: Gold/antialiased edge at x996-998, near-black band x999-1003, then background transition. Roughly 4-5 px dark edge at this row.

visual_observations.normal: 38; common blue-white burst in 1/2, orange digits with thick black edge in 3 and before_go; no long crit slash.
visual_observations.positive: 48; red glow with bright pale core in 3/4, thin fading slash in 5, beam gone in 6; digits stay orange.
visual_observations.negative: 58; purple/violet glow with bright pale core in 3/4, thin fading slash in 5, beam gone in 6; older nearby 78 is a separate event.
visual_observations.slash_geometry: Long tapered streak through the impact, behind digits, extending much farther above than below; longest samples are clipped by top screen edge.

mhgu_design_direction.omit: Shared blue-white hit flash in first two samples; MHGU already supplies hit effects. Preserve digit entrance.
mhgu_design_direction.digits: Broad rendered digits with thick nearly solid black outline and lightly softened outer edge; calibrate full outlined glyphs.
mhgu_design_direction.motion: Grow/shrink/settle, hold, small +4 reference-unit downward kick at exit, then upward alpha fade; time based, not one rendered frame at every FPS.
mhgu_design_direction.affinity: Red positive slash, purple negative slash, none for noncrit; digit palette remains independent of affinity.
mhgu_design_direction.slash_space: User identifies Rise slash as a world-space hit effect. MHGU uses a UI approximation anchored to the camera-projected saved hit point, independent of digit motion/placement; no ground clipping or scene occlusion in the current overlay path.
mhgu_design_direction.slash_height: Initial preview candidate: total vertical extent 1/2 gameplay viewport height. Compare 3/4 height; final size remains undecided. Keep slash outside digit collision bounds and give it a separate short lifetime.
mhgu_design_direction.angle: User revised target to approximately +/-15 degrees. Proposed slope s in [-1/4,+1/4], approximately +/-14.04 degrees. Choose once per hit; upward direction (s,-1) needs no trig.
mhgu_design_direction.classification: All styles share existing tint(): confirmed bounce -> Gray; otherwise physical HZV >=45 -> Weak; lower/unknown HZV -> White. No Rise-specific categories or companion tint rule.
mhgu_design_direction.other_colors: Share animation and outline behavior. Borrow Rise colors only, including OTOMO gray for bounce; style does not choose categorization.
